title: Your attachment style might explain your arguments

slides.title: Your *attachment style* might explain your arguments
slides.sub: Not a diagnosis. Just a lens that makes fights make sense.

slides.name: Secure
slides.title: The *steady* one
slides.fight: You stay calm, say how you feel and trust you’ll be okay.
slides.helps: Keep it up. Your steadiness helps both of you.

slides.name: Anxious
slides.title: The *fix it now* one
slides.fight: Silence feels scary, so you push to solve it right away.
slides.helps: Reassurance: “We’re okay. I just need a minute.”

slides.name: Avoidant
slides.title: The *needs space* one
slides.fight: You go quiet and need time before you can really talk.
slides.helps: Space to cool off, plus a promise to come back to it.

slides.name: Fearful-avoidant
slides.title: The *push and pull* one
slides.fight: You want closeness and space at the same time. It’s confusing.
slides.helps: Patience, consistency and naming feelings out loud.

slides.title: Save this *for after your next fight.*
slides.sub: Then guess each other’s style. Comment yours.
